200001/p0: "Hey, hey, Apollon. You seem popular, but it looks like your love affairs always end in heartbreak."
200001/p1: "Ouch!! Didi, what's this sudden question? Isn't it a bit too sudden?"
200001/p2: "Hmm, because I'm bored? I was wondering if there was any interesting gossip. When it's like this, it's all about love talk, right?"
200001/p3: "Just because you're bored doesn't mean you should dig up my emotional wounds! I'd rather you didn't."
200001/p4: "...True. When you fall in love, nothing good comes of it. Not for the other person, and not for you."
200001/p5: "Ugh... I don't want to hear that from my uncle! But I can't talk back... I can't talk back."
200001/p6: "For example~ his girlfriend of the laurel tree... like Daphne~. Even though he had the power of Eros's arrows."
200001/p7: "She prayed to her father to turn into a tree just to avoid Apollon. That's quite a way to handle a heartbreak~. Dramatic, I'd say~."
200001/p8: "Then there was also that girl who turned into a flower after being dumped by Apollon~. Wow, being popular is tough."
200001/p9: "Waaah... Waaah! That's terrible, terrible! You two don't know anything, nothing!"
200001/p10: "You didn't have to cry~. Did I tease you too much~? I only meant it as a little joke."
200001/p11: "Hey, think about me, who has to clean up the mess later. Even though he looks like that, once he starts complaining, it goes on forever."
200001/p12: "You're right. Sorry, sorry. I'll bring some oranges and go apologize~. Well, it'll probably work out."
201001/p0: "Hey, Dionysus. Stop lying around there. Get up quickly. We're going to be late."
201001/p1: "I know that... ow, ow. Ah, what a drag."
201001/p2: "My head hurts too. Did I let myself get carried away and drink too much wine~? Human bodies are just too weak~."
201001/p3: "This is really tough. Can't I take a break?"
201001/p4: "There's no need to ask me; it's obviously a no. Here, water."
201001/p6: "Good morning! Both of you, let's do our best as humans today too! Well, I'm off!"
201001/p7: "Hey, Apollon. You forgot your bag. Where do you think you're going?"
201001/p8: "Hahaha! Oh no, no. Thanks for saving me, Uncle. I'll be off again!"
201001/p10: "Come on, get ready too. I'll give you a piggyback ride to school. You're hopeless."
201001/p11: "Hades-san is so kind~. I'm starting to fall for him all over again~"
201001/p12: "Skip the flattery and get going. You're such a nuisance."
202001/p1: "Yes. Other gods also live together with those from the same mythology."
202001/p2: "Isn't it too cramped? I couldn't stand it for even a day. It's like a rabbit hutch."
202001/p3: "That's true. If it were rabbits, there's Usamaro."
202001/p5: "If you've got complaints, don't come here. Don't interrupt my time with my brother!"
202001/p6: "That's not what I mean. I'm worried about you as your older brother, Takeru."
202001/p7: "If the environment isn't right, you won't be able to learn anything."
202001/p8: "I don't feel any particular inconvenience. Meals are prepared with nutritional management in the dining hall."
202001/p9: "The thing I'm most concerned about is noise. Takeru Totsuka is a bit too loud."
202001/p10: "Tsukito! There are things you should and shouldn't say. What kind of tone is that towards a younger brother!"
202001/p11: "It's the truth... Takeru Totsuka, I apologize."
202001/p12: "My brother doesn't need to apologize! If you bully him, I won't show you any mercy!"
202001/p13: "Takeru... that wasn't my intention. Please, don't be angry."
202001/p15: "Ah, Takeru. Don't make that face. It's my fault..."
203001/p0: "Man, it's pretty refreshing just the three of us hanging out. Since we're here, why don't we do something?"
203001/p2: "Then how about we go climb the highest mountain in the Garden right now... or maybe a marathon across the grasslands..."
203001/p3: "Takeru, everything you suggest involves physical exertion. Is there nothing else?"
203001/p4: "My clothes are a bit restrictive, so I'd prefer to avoid going too far..."
203001/p5: "You're being selfish. ...Alright, then let's lift dumbbells in the room? That's what humans call weight training."
203001/p7: "This is nothing. Come on, let's start!"
203001/p9: "Let's sit down and calm down for now. I assume you don't expect Takeru to be the only one having fun, right?"
203001/p10: "Oh, Tsukito. Rarely do we agree on something."
203001/p11: "...? I didn't intend to agree, but I'm glad we share the same opinion."
203001/p12: "Alright then, let's sit and have an arm wrestling match!! That won't tire us out."
204001/p1: "I'm so happy that Thor is making dinner for us today."
204001/p2: "This is just like a family, sitting around the table together*"
204001/p3: "...The menu is... exactly as Balder requested."
204001/p7: "Mm-hmm. Healthy and nice. Oh, please leave the vegetables out for me."
204001/p8: "...The main course... is a steak made with premium meat."
204001/p11: "...Thor, aren't you spoiling Balder too much? It's unbalanced."
205001/p0: "...Loki, don't leave things in the common area."
205001/p2: "Ehhh, but it's cramped in my room! I'll clean it up later, so it's fine~*"
205001/p4: "It can't be helped* After all, they're all prank tools!"
205001/p5: "...Don't get so brazen. ...What if I trip on one?"
205001/p6: "I don't know~* It's your own responsibility, right? Besides, you wouldn't trip, would you, Thor?"
205001/p8: "I'm back. I'm starving. Let's go eat meat with everyone..."
205001/p10: "Ah, come on! Don't trigger it before I set it up~! Idiot~! I'll have to remake it!"
206001/p7: "Hmm. When that clock completes one full rotation."
206001/p8: "Grr, Rrrrrrr! (Got it! Anubis will be good and wait!)"
206001/p11: "Finally asleep. He repeats the same things every day without getting bored."
206001/p12: "It's so annoying that he's sleeping right here. I wish he'd sleep in his own bed. With such a carefree look on his face......"
207001/p0: "Grr~? Corn? (Thoth, do you want more corn?)"
207001/p2: "No matter how many times I bring it to my mouth, these golden grains continue to captivate me."
207001/p3: "Grr, vegetables? (Do you want to eat other vegetables too?)"
207001/p5: "Grr, no picky eating (I read in a book that it's not good to be picky)."
207001/p7: "For someone of my stature, a slight imbalance in diet is hardly a problem."
207001/p9: "Just leave it on the edge of the plate. ...I might eat it if I feel like it."
200002/p2: "What's that watering can and fertilizer for?"
200002/p3: "This is, um... just a coincidence. Hey, stop that!"
200002/p4: "Ah, Mr. Strawberry! It's Mr. Strawberry! It's cute, just like the color of Uncle's eyes. So shiny and sparkling."
200002/p5: "Don't use such creepy comparisons... That's going too far."
200002/p6: "Really? I think they're beautiful. I like them? They're very beautiful."
200002/p7: "...Honestly. Meeting you is like a one-time strawberry incident. Just kidding..."
201002/p0: "Uncle has such a unique personality. He's reliable and cool, but he says funny things too."
201002/p1: "I don't want to hear that from a weirdo like you. Besides, no one has ever said that to me before."
201002/p2: "Really? I think everyone else finds it strange too. He suddenly starts telling jokes."
201002/p3: "That's... only when it's necessary. I'm not saying them just because I want to."
201002/p4: "Is that so! I thought it was just his hobby, his hobby. Then why does he say them?"
201002/p6: "Uncle... you don't have to force yourself to be funny, you know?"
202002/p0: "Bro, walking is fun! Usamaro is overjoyed! I'm happy to be included with you, bro."
202002/p1: "This is training to use Usamaro as a familiar, not for amusement."
202002/p2: "As expected, bro is serious. This is what they call killing two birds with one stone, right?"
202002/p3: "Hey! Speak of the devil! Look at that bird flying in the sky! It's so cute. Hey there!"
202002/p4: "...In the idiom 'killing two birds with one stone,' the bird is the one that gets shot. Its appearance here isn't exactly desirable, is it?"
202002/p5: "...Takeru Totsuka. This is a task for two people. There's no need for you to tag along."
202002/p6: "Are you worried about my schedule? But don't worry, I'm fine! I'm working out my body like this anyway."
202002/p7: "Talking like this is making me want to run. I'll go for a quick jog!"
202002/p8: "I'm losing track of which walk we're on, Usamaro."
203002/p0: "It's nice to just relax like this. Studying all the time can be suffocating!"
203002/p1: "I came here for that purpose. You shouldn't complain."
203002/p2: "...However, looking down at the courtyard from up here isn't bad either. Thank you for inviting me."
203002/p3: "Hehe. This is my favorite spot. I'm only telling you because you're my big brother."
203002/p5: "That's right. Since we're here, I brought some hot tea and manjuu..."
203002/p8: "...Hah. This isn't so bad either. Let's take it easy, big bro."
204002/p0: "Balder~! You worked hard today~ I brought you some snacks*"
204002/p1: "Thanks for your hard work too, Loki. Thank you for going out of your way."
204002/p2: "Drinks and~ delicious sweets! Here, open wide for me*"
204002/p7: "Huh... Loki, he's gone. Maybe it wasn't for me after all. What a strange kid. Hehe."
205002/p0: "Walking through the snow like this reminds me of the world I came from."
205002/p1: "That's true. I think we used to sneak away from Odin's eyes and ride Sleipnir together, didn't we?"
205002/p2: "After we graduate from this academy and return to our own world, will we still be as close as we are now?"
205002/p4: "Just a feeling. I felt like saying that."
205002/p5: "You don't need to ask again; I already know the answer."
205002/p6: "That's right. Loki is my best friend."
205002/p7: "...That's right. After all, Balder is my best friend. You're irreplaceable."
206002/p0: "Kaa! Barabara! Barara... (Hey! Bird! Go away! Ah, I'm being eaten again!))"
206002/p1: "Kaa, barabara~ (I'm trying to grow more corn for Thoth, but it's so difficult...))"
206002/p3: "Kaa, barabarabara~. (Is it because we're outside the school that I can't visit as often?))"
206002/p4: "What nerve you have, acting like a mere bird."
206002/p6: "Now then, how shall I deal with you..."
206002/p9: "Kaa! Barabara! (Thoth! Anubis will convey it properly, so please don't bully him!))"
206002/p10: "...Is that so? Then manage it carefully. Mistakes are not tolerated. Farewell."
206002/p11: "Kaaa, barabara... (Phew... that was a close one. Dangerous~))"
207002/p2: "Kaa! Barabaraa (It's been like that for a while now.)"
207002/p4: "Kaa! Barabara!! (Don't push yourself! Work is over!)"
207002/p5: "What are you doing? This isn't play."
207002/p8: "Barabara... Kaa! (I know, Anubis. You're overworking yourself.)"
207002/p9: "Kaa, Barabara!! (No one might notice, but I do!)"
207002/p10: "Fuu... I never thought I'd get lectured by you."
207002/p11: "My focus is broken. I'll take the rest of the day off."
200003/p0: "Alright, everyone! We're going to have a tea party now!"
200003/p1: "Humans deepen their friendships by enjoying tea like this, you know."
200003/p2: "Holding it outdoors seems to free the mind and allow for more effective bonding."
200003/p3: "It's not bad to relax with everyone once in a while. The sunshine feels nice."
200003/p4: "Per the president's instructions, I purchased green tea, black tea, and oolong tea, along with a variety of other beverages."
200003/p5: "Thank you, Tsukitsuki! I asked my uncle to make lots of sweets for me!"
200003/p6: "Alright, let's rest with all our might! You should always tackle things with full effort. Let's do our best at this tea party!"
200003/p7: "...If you do it with all your might, isn't that the opposite of resting? Well, it is very much like us, so that's fine."
201003/p1: "Uncle! Welcome to the Student Council. What's the matter? This is rare. Do you need something from me?"
201003/p2: "No. If it were about you, the dorm would suffice. I came to deliver this."
201003/p3: "Usamaro... Now that you mention it, I was wondering where he'd been since this morning."
201003/p4: "He was in the hutch of the land turtle I'm caring for. Letting him roam free isn't bad, but be careful."
201003/p5: "Still, he's as plump as ever. He looks delicious. I almost want to eat him. He's so cute."
201003/p7: "What a shame. Talking about meat made me hungry."
201003/p8: "Then shall we all go eat? Or should we buy some sweets at the shop?"
202003/p0: "I have a question. How exactly should one weave words of love?"
202003/p1: "You don't need to overthink it! Just speak your feelings as they well up inside you, like a fountain!"
202003/p2: "Such words are not used in daily life. Therefore, they do not well up."
202003/p3: "Is that so? For example, may I gaze upon your figure, blooming beautifully like a flower... or something along those lines?"
202003/p4: "Or perhaps, 'You are my little bird... I wish to keep you locked in a cage named after me forever'...?"
202003/p5: "Flowers... birds... It seems important to compare them to something."
202003/p7: "Hmm, that... I don't think so. Why anpan?"
202003/p8: "I ate it earlier. That impression must have been strong."
202003/p9: "It slipped out of my mouth unconsciously. I will be careful in the future."
202003/p10: "Yeah... You don't need to apologize to us, but it's better to be careful when the moment calls for it."
203003/p0: "Hey, Anii! There you are. I've been looking all over for you."
203003/p1: "Shh, Takeru... You mustn't raise your voice in the library."
203003/p2: "Hehe, were you happy to see your brother? I'll be done with this work soon, so please wait here."
203003/p3: "Uh, yeah... How did you figure that out?"
203003/p4: "Tsukitsuki, I'm doing the decorations, but I was thinking of pulling an all-nighter tomorrow to get it all done. Could you help me?"
203003/p5: "What are you saying to Anii?! That's impossible, obviously. Apollo can just do it by himself."
203003/p6: "Takeru. Do not interfere with my mission. Understood."
203003/p7: "To finish everything in one day, let's start preparing tonight."
203003/p8: "Are you really okay? Are you sure? Taketake is glaring at me so intensely..."
203003/p11: "Hehe, how cute. Brave, or perhaps futile. It makes me feel warm just watching you."
204003/p0: "Hmm. It's nice to take a leisurely stroll at a speed that won't make us trip."
204003/p1: "That's true! And today, there are cute, tiny guests too!"
204003/p2: "That's true. But he's been sticking to my feet this whole time, and I'm worried I might step on him."
204003/p3: "It seems U-sama-ro has taken quite a liking to you. As your familiar, I should be able to control it with power, but it's completely ineffective."
204003/p4: "In the face of Balbal's charm, anything and everything falls head over heels. I'm almost jealous."
204003/p5: "That's not the case. Besides, it's not all good things. I get pulled along, and conflicts arise."
204003/p8: "It's true. Being popular is tough. It's really tough..."
205003/p0: "Totsuka-nii~? I've got a question for you. What exactly are ninjas hiding from?"
205003/p1: "Ninjas!! Samurai!! I'm interested in that question too!"
205003/p2: "Since their profession is stealth operations, I suppose they are hiding from the world."
205003/p3: "Really!? In the manga I read recently, they were wearing bright blue, eye-catching clothes..."
205003/p4: "Then, then~~ What do ninjas do during the day? I have a strong image of them working at night."
205003/p5: "Now that you mention it, that's true. Maybe they eat tempura at night to build up their strength!?"
205003/p7: "But if they ate that every day, they'd get fat! Maybe they're making shuriken or something? Or maybe kusarigama?"
205003/p8: "Because they're hiding from the world, they can't rely on other people, right? If you asked someone to make shuriken, they'd find out."
205003/p10: "I see... Ninjas are skilled, huh. So does that mean they do side jobs during the day?"
205003/p11: "I'll look into it and let you know by tomorrow."
206003/p1: "Oh, juggling, huh? I didn't know oranges could be used like that. But you're really good at it."
206003/p4: "Grr! Ba-ba-ba? (Yeah! Can Anubis try it too?)"
206003/p5: "You want to try? Sure, sure! I'll lend them to you."
206003/p9: "Oh dear... It's like an anime. All the oranges hitting his head."
207003/p0: "We've arrived~! Come on, come on, come on~! Let's enjoy our lunch break!"
207003/p1: "Apollon Agana Belea. It would be for your own good if you kept quiet."
207003/p2: "I wonder why. It's a precious break time."
207003/p3: Tsukito silently pointed to the bench in the back.
207003/p5: "He's sleeping so comfortably. If we wake him up, he'll be super, super angry."
207003/p9: "I said I wanted it hard-boiled... *nuzzle*... I said..."
207003/p12: "This is truly 'don't touch the gods, or they'll curse you'... isn't it."
200004/p0: "Move it. Apollon, thanks for lending me that book. It was pretty good."
200004/p1: "Really? That's great. I thought you'd like it."
200004/p2: "Oh? It's rare to see you two sharing books. What's it about?"
200004/p3: "It's 'The Drifter ~Jellyfish Samurai~'! It's super, super cool! A solitary samurai drifting through life, burdened by the world's sorrow..."
200004/p4: "He stabs his enemies without feeling a thing. The Jellyfish Samurai is none other than me! ...Don't get carried away, you idiot."
200004/p5: "Aww, Taa-tan, you're here! Hey, Apollon, wanna test out a new toy I made?"
200004/p6: "Yeah, sure! Sure! I'm up for anything. I wonder what it is?"
200004/p7: "It's an aerial swing that lets you fly higher the stupider you are! Sounds fun, right?"
200004/p8: "That sounds fun. But can I do it well? Takeru, let's go! Let's, go-go!"
200004/p10: "Good grief, what noisy kids. Is this what youth is like..."
201004/p0: "The sun is strong today, so the shade will be nice. Sadah, take it easy."
201004/p1: "Oh, Hades-san. What are you doing, squatting over there?"
201004/p2: "As you can see, I'm basking in the sun like a turtle."
201004/p4: "Sadah is wise. They say animals resemble their owners, and he's quiet and obedient."
201004/p5: "Nnn? Nnn? Death, are you showing off indirectly?"
201004/p6: "S-Suddenly appearing is rude. That's not what I meant. I was just telling Takeru about Sadah's greatness."
201004/p7: "If he resembles Death, does that mean this turtle is super unlucky?"
201004/p8: "...That's how it looks. Sorry, Sadah. Because of me..."
201004/p9: "You don't have to be so down! Sadah is happy just being kept by you, Hades-san!"
202004/p0: "It's rare to have a meal with all of us, isn't it? Since we're here, let's do something fun~* I want to eat deliciously and have a good time, don't you?"
202004/p1: "I believe a meal is simply for filling the stomach."
202004/p2: "That's not true! Do you have picky eating habits, Totsuka-nii?"
202004/p3: "I like delicious food, and I dislike food that tastes bad."
202004/p5: "Then, Nii-san. How about this? It's tempura soba."
202004/p7: "Then, how about this? It's a food called kusaya. It smells terrible, but apparently it's tasty."
202004/p8: "It's bad. It doesn't suit my palate, though it seems to have what they call 'umami'."
203004/p0: "Hey, hey, a question~* What do you think is an animal that looks like me~?"
203004/p2: "It's part of our studies! Apparently, humans ask questions like this at parties called 'Gouken'."
203004/p3: "I'm a lion, obviously. They call me the king of beasts, so it fits perfectly."
203004/p4: "I suppose your hairstyle does resemble a lion's mane."
203004/p5: "Hehe~! See? If you're a man, a lion is the only choice!"
203004/p6: "But you also look a bit like a hedgehog. The prickly parts and the overall size."
203004/p7: "Hii-hya-hya-hya!! That's hilarious~! That one fits even better*"
204004/p0: "Hey, hey, I've been wanting to ask you for a while. Are you a samurai!? I'd be happy if you were."
204004/p2: "But I heard you were scolded by your older brother for using a sword."
204004/p3: "I know you do kendo in your club activities, but can you use a sword as well?"
204004/p4: "Kendo!! That's wonderful. Well, maybe you could be a samurai after all?"
204004/p5: "Then you'd better get a topknot! A topknot~!"
204004/p7: "According to the book~ it seems there are all sorts of types?"
204004/p8: "Indeed. The style that sticks straight up on top has quite an impact. It's a strange hairstyle I've never seen before."
204004/p9: "Don't just run with your own assumptions!"
205004/p0: "Ah~ Death and Taku! You're in just the right spot~!"
205004/p1: "What the... I'm talking to Hades, so don't get in the way."
205004/p2: "What's with that tone! I was going to give you something nice, you know!"
205004/p3: "Seeds for rare plants and a cute bird encyclopedia! I thought you'd both like them. I found them at the store."
205004/p5: "It's not gonna explode the moment I take it, is it...?"
205004/p6: "See? I really didn't put anything in it. I just happened to find it! You don't believe me at all, do you?"
205004/p7: "I'd say it's unreasonable to ask me to believe that..."
206004/p0: "Kaa-barabara? (Is Haa the king of the underworld? Is he great?)"
206004/p1: "Whether one is great or not is not something to decide for oneself. Just because I'm called a king doesn't mean I'm anything more than a mere administrator. I think I'm no different from you."
206004/p3: "Both of you are gods associated with the dead, but your vibes are totally different!"
206004/p5: "If anything, they're complete opposites. In personality and appearance too. It's harder to find commonalities than differences."
206004/p6: "Kaa~ barabara? (But they're good friends, aren't they?)"
206004/p7: "Kaa-barabara! (Last time, we made lots of Mi's friends together. It was fun, right!)"
206004/p8: "Since he's a god of death, 'Ta no shinda' (Ta died)."
207004/p0: "Whoa~! This aerial swing~! Isn't it fun?"
207004/p1: "Whoa! It's floating pretty high. The ride isn't bad."
207004/p2: "Hey, watch out. Don't forget you're in a human body."
207004/p5: "Sensei! ...No, wait, this is an invention! I'm not using any divine power."
207004/p6: "It seems to be a vehicle whose altitude increases in proportion to intelligence."
207004/p7: "Hmm. So the more foolish you are, the higher you fly. Like a kite, it goes up well."
207004/p8: "Hey! How do I get down from this? It's going up more and more!"
207004/p9: "Hmph. You have no sense of limits..."
200005/p1: "...I'll make sure to give Loki a good talking-to."
200005/p2: "Don't trouble yourself with me. I'm already exasperated enough by this situation."
200005/p3: "...I can only imagine how you feel, Sensei Thoth."
200005/p4: "Words are easy. Show it with your actions."
200005/p6: "...I heard you like them. ...They say they're freshly picked."
200005/p9: "Hey, you two~! What are you doing? Hey, hey?"
200005/p10: "Wow! That corn looks delicious. Nice, nice~!"
200005/p11: "...Should I do the same for Apollon?"
200005/p12: "Thanks, Toru-Toru! Well, in return, I'll give you an orange. And Sensei Thoth, help yourself! Want me to peel it for you?"
200005/p13: "No need. If I stay near fools, I catch their foolishness. Besides, you have nothing to offer me."
200005/p14: "That's harsh! You're treating me so differently than you did Toru-Toru. It's completely different."
200005/p15: "...You're not at fault. ...The timing was just bad."
201005/p0: "Oh? How unusual. Do you have business with the principal?"
201005/p1: "Yes, Zeus summoned me. I'd rather not see his face, but I have no choice."
201005/p2: "I can hardly talk, but your sibling relationship isn't exactly harmonious either, is it?"
201005/p3: "I don't resent our circumstances. I simply dislike his unreasonable behavior."
201005/p5: "So, I've been curious about this look of yours. Is it a provocation aimed at Zeus? You're trying awfully hard to look young."
201005/p7: "Oh... Did I perhaps ask something I shouldn't have?"
201005/p8: "Well, it's fine, isn't it? You're in human form, so you're free to do as you please. See you later."
201005/p9: "...I hadn't noticed. Do you do it unconsciously?"
201005/p10: "...There's no need to worry about it."
201005/p11: "Is there not? If those around you are looking at me with such eyes, then I..."
201005/p16: "...Flawless white skin. ...Everything about you is younger than Zeus's."
201005/p18: "...But... since it suits you, isn't that fine?"
201005/p20: "...Could you leave me alone for a bit?"
202005/p0: "Hey, Tsukito. Anubis is asking if you want to play hide-and-seek. Will you join us?"
202005/p2: "Sure. If you don't mind, I'll join you."
202005/p3: "Kaa! Kaa, bara! (Tsukito, I love you! I'm happy!)"
202005/p5: "Hide well. Alright, I'll start counting. One... two... three..."
202005/p6: "Alright, I think that's enough counting. Now, let's go find you. Oh, there you are, Tsukito."
202005/p7: "I forgot to confirm how far I'm allowed to hide. Even games need rules."
202005/p8: "You're so serious. Anyway, let's look for Anubis together."
202005/p9: "He's hard to find. He's good at hiding. The lamp is brightest right under itself, so let's check the classroom."
202005/p11: "Hold on a sec. Doesn't that look suspicious? The equipment box in the back of the classroom."
202005/p13: "Found you~. You were the one who suggested playing, and now you're asleep. You look so cute~."
202005/p14: "Kaaa~ Bara~ba~raaaa~. (Anubis is having fun... Let's play more.)"
203005/p1: "What, you're hungry too? Hey, don't tickle me. Stop poking my face. Hahaha."
203005/p2: "Oh, looks like someone's already here. I was going to take a nap."
203005/p3: "This shade feels nice, doesn't it? I like this spot too."
203005/p8: "Don't decide things for me! That's not true, right? I'm the better guy."
203005/p13: "I see. Then I'll prepare something for you."
203005/p17: "I guess it's instinct. Animals are honest."
204005/p0: "Being out in the sun calms me down."
204005/p1: "That's right. You're the god of the sun, after all."
204005/p2: "Balder is also a god of light. Perhaps it's no coincidence that we're drawn to each other."
204005/p3: "You seem to get along with me better than Tsukito does."{op:038c:0100}{op:038d:01002d5d8000}
204005/p5: "I'm not flattering you. I don't say things I don't mean."
204005/p7: "...Wait, what is this sparkling space? Having two beautiful ladies with silky, flowing hair really adds to the drama~"
204005/p8: "Thyrsus, welcome. Would you like to join us for some sunbathing? It feels wonderful."
204005/p9: "...Hmm, I'll pass. A bunch of birds are gathering, and it's a little scary."
204005/p10: "Birds flocking together is natural, isn't it? Is that really so strange?"
204005/p13: "Grr... scattered! (Anubis joins in too! Sparkly and beautiful!)"
204005/p14: "I don't dislike honest people. You may come closer."
204005/p16: "Even Anubis, who's so shy... I guess he's not exactly normal either..."
205005/p0: "Nyu-so~! You're in a good spot~* I've got a question for you. What do you think love is?"
205005/p1: "...As abrupt as ever~. And your question is one that doesn't really have an answer, does it~?"
205005/p2: "Isn't it just that you're not thinking about it seriously? It's okay to be wrong, so just answer me. I'll take it as one perspective."
205005/p3: "Could you not base your conversation on the premise that I'm wrong? That hurts my feelings, even for me."
205005/p4: "I see~. If I were to answer seriously, I'd say it's the greatest joy... or something like that."
205005/p5: "In love, even sorrow is beautiful. I think it's the supreme exchange of emotions woven with another person."
205005/p6: "...That's kind of shady and not a very satisfying answer."
205005/p8: "Then let's ask Sensei~. He is a teacher, after all. Hey..."
205005/p11: "Everything is a waste of time. You have no right to steal my precious break time."
205005/p12: "Sensei might be right~! It might be useless to ask Nyu-so! Let's go ask Death~!"
206005/p2: "I see. Then I'll come back later."
206005/p4: "...So you were hiding there. ...I didn't notice."
206005/p6: "Anubis, do you know where Thoth is?"
206005/p7: "Kaa kaa! Barabara~ (Ah's clothes, swish swish, swaying! Pretty!)"
206005/p8: "Hey, don't cling so much. You'll trip."
206005/p13: "I wish my younger brother was this obedient."
206005/p14: "...Agreed. ...I wish my companions would learn from him."
207005/p0: "Come up with a better way to grow corn. If you're a god in charge of fertility, that should be a piece of cake, shouldn't it?"
207005/p1: "Eh? That's such a crazy request... My specialty is grapes, you know."
207005/p3: "Yes! Understood~. I'll do it. I guess I just have to do it, right?"
207005/p5: "Did you say something? If you have the leisure to chatter, move your hands instead."
207005/p6: "I wonder why I ended up stuck with this guy~... Sigh..."
207005/p9: "I have something to talk to you about."
207005/p10: "...By the way, what are you doing?"
207005/p11: "I'm thinking about efficient ways to grow corn."
207005/p12: "I think it's better to leave it to the laws of nature."
207005/p13: "I think so too~. But it feels like my life might be in danger if I don't do something."
207005/p15: "That's it! Yo, use the power of the sun god to shine on them quickly, okay?"
207005/p16: "Then it'll be done in one shot, right~?"
207005/p17: "What do you think the power of a god is?"
